name: theme
title: Glaze theme
description: Support file: tokens, scoped base styles, the Tailwind v4 theme mapping and Glaze's recipes: glass, the card shell, the pill field and the overlay.
author: design.how
docs:
Glaze is scoped: its styles apply only inside an element with the class glaze.
1. Import the theme once, in the root layout, as its own stylesheet (not an @import in globals.css): import '@/components/glaze/styles.css'
2. Put className="glaze" on the element that holds Glaze UI, usually <body>. Glaze's classes work on the elements inside it, in your own code too, not on that element itself.
3. Wrap the app inside that element in <GlazePortalProvider> from '@/lib/glaze/portal', so dialogs and menus keep the theme.
Dark mode: put data-theme="dark" on the glaze element or any ancestor, such as <html>. The theme does not follow the system setting (prefers-color-scheme) on its own.
Components: npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/glaze/<name>.json; https://design.how/r/glaze/registry.json lists them all.

files.content:
/* Glaze tokens. The one file to retune.

   Glaze is compact and black and white, for AI products. Its one signature is glass on the things you press.

   Rules
   - Ink is the brand. Ink is #050505, a neutral near-black, and nothing shows it solid: text is ink at 80%, a soft dark grey, and every grey
     is ink at an alpha (80, 60, 45, 32, 15, 10, 6, 3), so a grey always sits between the text and the page it is on. There is no brand accent.
   - Colour means status only: green for done, amber for a warning, coral for a failure and a destructive action.
     Focus is ink, never coral, so a focused field never reads as an error.
   - Glass goes only on what a person presses: the primary button family and icon buttons. Everything else is flat.
     The glass recipe is the Glass group below: ink, coral and green are the primary button's three keys. A value
     chosen inside a small control (a ticked checkbox or radio, the switch on, the slider, the segmented thumb, a
     picked day, a progress fill) takes small glaze, the Small glaze group, drawn for 12 to 20px. Only the primary
     family is glass. The secondary button is the plain card surface: paper, a text-1 label
     and the panel's hairline (the Flat group), so the one glass pill in a group is always the lead.
   - No shadows. Depth is a layer drawn inside a shape: the glass's sheen, dark centre and rim, the shell around a panel.
     An overlay lifts with a 1px ink ring on a page a step darker than paper. --shadow-none is the only shadow token.
   - Text a person reads takes --text-1 or --text-2 (5.5:1 on paper, the floor). --text-3 is ink at 45%, 3.3:1,
     for placeholders and icons beside a label, never for a sentence or a value.
   - Mono inside sans text is set at --mono-scale of the surrounding size, on the same baseline, in the parent's line
     height. Glaze Sans and Glaze Mono share an x-height of 0.51em and a cap height of 0.715em, but a mono lowercase
     letter is 0.600em wide against the sans's 0.478em average, 26% wider, so at the same size mono reads a size
     bigger. At 0.8 its letters are 0.480em, level with the sans. Geist, the first fallback, is 0.528em, so there
     mono at 0.8 runs 9% narrower than the sans: small, never big. The 0.8 is for mono in or beside a line of sans only.
     Code on its own in a block (code block, JSON view, log viewer) has no sans to match and is read line by line, so it
     takes --type-code-block, 12px on a 20px line.

   Format, read by the docs
   - One declaration per line: --name: value; followed by a comment of the form job | used by.
   - A line that starts with == opens a token group. Keep both formats when you retune.

   Scope: the tokens live on .glaze and [data-system="glaze"], not :root, so an app's own --space-* and --font-*
   stay as they are.

   Fonts: Glaze Sans and Glaze Mono are declared on design.how's own Glaze pages only and are not bundled with the
   theme. An installed Glaze renders the next name in each stack: Geist and Geist Mono (SIL OFL) if the app loads
   them, else the platform UI sans and monospace. With a licence of your own, declare @font-face rules named
   "Glaze Sans" (400 and 500 for every word, 600 for strong) and "Glaze Mono" (400 and 500, 600 for emphasis) and the stacks pick them up. */

[data-system="glaze"], .glaze {
  /* == Surfaces == */
  --page: #fbfbfa; /* the page, a half step darker than paper: a paper overlay still lifts off it and the grey shell reads as the card | app background, docs preview */
  --paper: #ffffff; /* paper: the panel inside a card, a field, an overlay | panel, input, menu, popover, dialog */
  --shell: #f1f1f0; /* the light grey shell a card's panel sits in, and the footer row on it | card shell, card footer */
  --field: #efefef; /* the one grey field: a well for output, a track | tool call well, switch track, progress track */
  --code-surface: var(--paper); /* where a block of code sits: paper, with the panel's hairline when it stands alone, so small dark mono reads on the lightest surface | code block, JSON view, log viewer */
  --hover: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.06); /* ink at 6%: a row or a plain button under the pointer | menu item, row, ghost button */
  --hover-row: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.035); /* ink at 3.5%: a list row under the pointer, lighter than the selected row's --pressed | item, table row, data grid row */
  --pressed: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.10); /* ink at 10%: a plain button held, a selected row | ghost button active, selected row */
  --scrim: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.24); /* the dim behind a dialog: ink at 24% | dialog, sheet */

  /* == Ink == */
  --ink: #050505; /* solid ink, a neutral near-black: every text and line is this at an alpha | chart mark, tooltip */
  --ink-80: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.80); /* ink at 80%, 11.9:1 on paper: the text colour | text-1, focus ring */
  --ink-60: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.60); /* ink at 60%, 5.5:1 on paper | text-2 */
  --ink-45: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.45); /* ink at 45%, 3.3:1 on paper: a mark or a control edge, not text | text-3, line-strong */
  --ink-32: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.32); /* ink at 32%: a focused field's line, about a third | line-focus, text-disabled */
  --ink-15: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.15); /* ink at 15%: a field's resting line | line-control */
  --ink-10: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.10); /* ink at 10%: an overlay's ring | line */
  --ink-06: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.06); /* ink at 6%: the shell's and the panel's edge, a row rule | line-faint */
  --ink-03: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.03); /* ink at 3%: the faintest wash | striped row, quiet hover on grey */

  /* == Text == */
  --text-1: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.80); /* primary text, ink at 80%, 11.9:1 on paper | headings, body, labels, values */
  --text-2: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.60); /* secondary text, 5.5:1 on paper and 5.3:1 on the page, the floor for reading | descriptions, hints, meta */
  --text-3: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.45); /* placeholders and icons beside a label, 3.3:1; never a sentence | placeholder, leading icon */
  --text-disabled: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.32); /* a disabled label; no contrast claim | disabled control */
  --text-inverse: #ffffff; /* text on solid ink | tooltip, ink glass label */

  /* == Lines == */
  --line-faint: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.06); /* the shell's and the panel's edge, the rule between rows | card, panel, row rule */
  --line: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.10); /* an overlay's 1px ring and a divider that must read | menu, popover, dialog, separator */
  --line-control: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.15); /* a field's hairline at rest | input, select, textarea */
  --line-focus: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.32); /* a field's hairline with the cursor in it: darker, never black | input, select, textarea, prompt input */
  --line-strong: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.45); /* the edge of an empty control, 3.3:1 on paper (WCAG 1.4.11) | checkbox, radio, switch off */
  --focus: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.80); /* the focus ring: ink at the text's 80%, so focus never reads as an error | every focusable */

  /* == Status: green, amber and coral, each a mark, a word and a tint == */
  --ok: #2c9a59; /* done: a status mark | status mark, progress done */
  --ok-text: #1a7640; /* the done word, 5.7:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on its tint | status word, success message */
  --ok-tint: #e6f4ea; /* the done ground | success badge, success alert */
  --warn: #d98a0b; /* a warning mark | status mark */
  --warn-text: #8a5a00; /* the warning word, 5.9:1 on paper, 5.2:1 on its tint | status word, warning message */
  --warn-tint: #fbf0d9; /* the warning ground | warning badge, warning alert */
  --fail: #e35e49; /* coral: a failure mark and the coral glass's top | status mark, invalid field line, destructive button */
  --fail-text: #b23c29; /* the failure word, 5.9:1 on paper, 5.0:1 on its tint | error message, status word */
  --fail-tint: #fbe9e5; /* the failure ground | error badge, error alert */

  /* == Glass: the press recipe, a glossy glaze over the reference's overlay stack; ink, coral and green are the primary's keys == */
  --glass-ink-base: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.66); /* ink glass, the body: black at 66% over what is behind it, a grey on white (the reference's 56%, darkened so the label holds over the catch-light) | primary button, icon button */
  --glass-ink-text: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.90); /* the label on ink glass, white at 90%: 6.3:1 on the body over paper; at least 5.6:1 for nine in ten glyph pixels with the catch-light and centre drawn | primary button */
  --glass-ink-ring: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.56); /* ink glass, the 0.75px ring outside the edge | primary button */
  --glass-coral-base: rgb(150 34 18 / 0.88); /* coral glass, the body at the ink's translucent depth | destructive button */
  --glass-coral-text: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.90); /* the label on coral glass, 5.6:1 on the body over paper | destructive button */
  --glass-coral-ring: rgb(110 24 12 / 0.56); /* coral glass, its 0.75px ring | destructive button */
  --glass-green-base: rgb(6 86 40 / 0.88); /* green glass, the body at the ink's translucent depth | confirm button */
  --glass-green-text: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.90); /* the label on green glass, 5.6:1 on the body over paper | confirm button */
  --glass-green-ring: rgb(4 64 28 / 0.56); /* green glass, its 0.75px ring | confirm button */
  --glass-sheen: 0.12; /* the sheen, white to clear from top to bottom, at this opacity; 0.16 under the pointer, 0 held | glass */
  --glass-sheen-hover: 0.16; /* the sheen under the pointer | glass hover */
  --glass-core: 0.32; /* the dark centre, a radial of black under the label | glass */
  --glass-core-held: 0.44; /* the dark centre while held | glass active */
  --glass-rim: 0.24; /* the 1px rim, white and grey bands masked to the edge, at this opacity | glass */
  --glass-glaze: 0.06; /* the glaze: the upper half lit white at this opacity with a hard break at the middle | glass */
  --glass-gloss: 0.28; /* the catch-light, the bright pill across the top half, at this opacity | glass */
  --glass-blur: 6px; /* the backdrop blur under the translucent body | glass, flat */
  --gloss-inset: 0.28; /* how far the catch-light stops short of each end, as a share of the control's height | glass, flat */
  --gloss-top: 1.5px; /* the gap between the edge and the catch-light; optical, off the 4px grid on purpose | glass, flat */
  --gloss-height: 44%; /* how much of the body the catch-light covers | glass, flat */

  /* == Flat: the secondary button, the plain card surface: paper, the panel's hairline, a text-1 label; never glass == */
  --flat-bg: var(--paper); /* the secondary's body: the panel's paper, opaque | secondary button, button group text */
  --flat-ring: var(--line-faint); /* its 1px ring: the panel's hairline | secondary button */
  --flat-text: var(--text-1); /* its label | secondary button */
  --flat-hover: #f8f8f8; /* the surface a flat row takes under the pointer: paper under ink at 3% | select trigger hover */

  /* == Switch: off is a grey track with a light knob; on, the track is small glaze and the knob stays light == */
  --switch-off: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.10); /* the off track, ink at 10% | switch */
  --switch-knob: #ffffff; /* the knob while off, paper | switch */
  --switch-mark: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.60); /* the pending arc on the off knob, which is light in both themes | switch pending */

  /* == Small glaze: the press recipe drawn for 12 to 20px, a short gradient from a lifted grey to ink with a soft middle, a 1px top highlight and a faint rim; no catch-light == */
  --glaze-sm-top: #6b6b6b; /* the lifted grey at the top (the start, run sideways), 4.8:1 under the white glyph | checkbox, radio, switch on, slider, segmented thumb, progress fill */
  --glaze-sm-mid: #3d3d3d; /* the soft middle, at half way, 9.5:1 under the white glyph | glaze-sm */
  --glaze-sm-bottom: #232323; /* the ink grey at the bottom (the end, run sideways) | glaze-sm */
  --glaze-sm-highlight: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.30); /* the crisp 1px inner line along the top edge | glaze-sm */
  --glaze-sm-rim: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); /* the faint 0.5px rim outside the edge | glaze-sm */
  --glaze-sm-text: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92); /* the tick, dash and dot on it: 6.7:1 or better where a glyph sits | checkbox, radio, segmented thumb label */

  /* == Elevation == */
  --shadow-none: none; /* the only shadow Glaze has: nothing casts one, overlays included | every element */

  /* == Type == */
  --font-sans: "Glaze Sans", "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; /* every word | all text */
  --font-mono: "Glaze Mono", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; /* code, IDs, keys and paths | code, kbd, IDs */
  --mono-scale: 0.8; /* mono at this share of the sans it sits in or beside, so it never looks bigger; never a block of code | mono, type-code roles */
  --weight-normal: 400; /* running text | body, caption */
  --weight-medium: 500; /* labels, controls and headings: the same cut as text in Glaze Sans, a step up in a fallback | label, button, heading */
  --weight-semibold: 600; /* small strong emphasis inside prose, never a title | strong */
  --type-title: 500 28px/1.2 var(--font-sans); /* the page title */
  --type-heading: 500 20px/1.3 var(--font-sans); /* a section or dialog title | section, dialog title */
  --type-heading-sm: 500 16px/1.35 var(--font-sans); /* a subsection or card title at its largest | subsection, empty state title */
  --type-body: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); /* paragraphs, 1.5 | message, description */
  --type-body-sm: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-sans); /* dense paragraphs and descriptions | card description, field hint */
  --type-label: 500 13px/1.35 var(--font-sans); /* controls and labels, 1.35 | button, input, menu item, card title */
  --type-label-sm: 500 12px/1.35 var(--font-sans); /* a small control, a tag, a column head | small button, badge, table head */
  --type-label-lg: 500 14px/1.35 var(--font-sans); /* a large control | large button */
  --type-caption: 400 12px/1.35 var(--font-sans); /* meta beside a value | timestamp, count, card footer meta */
  --type-code: 400 calc(14px * var(--mono-scale))/1.5 var(--font-mono); /* standalone mono beside body text: 11.2px | shell prompt, a code line in a sentence's place */
  --type-code-sm: 400 calc(13px * var(--mono-scale))/1.5 var(--font-mono); /* standalone mono beside body-sm or a label: 10.4px | table IDs, key tails */
  --type-code-xs: 400 calc(12px * var(--mono-scale))/1.35 var(--font-mono); /* standalone mono beside a caption: 9.6px | footer meta, row IDs */
  --type-code-block: 400 12px/20px var(--font-mono); /* a block of code read line by line, with no sans beside it to match: 12px on a 20px line | code block, JSON view, log viewer */
  --tracking-heading: -0.025em; /* titles and headings | title, heading, heading-sm */
  --tracking-body: 0em; /* body and captions: the display cut sets tight on its own, so text takes no tracking | body, caption */
  --tracking-label: 0.02em; /* labels and controls, opened a touch as in the reference button | label, button, menu item */

  /* == Space == */
  --space-0-5: 2px; /* an optical nudge | icon offset */
  --space-1: 4px; /* the grid's step: icon to label in a tag | tag, badge */
  --space-1-5: 6px; /* icon to label inside a control | button, chip */
  --space-2: 8px; /* between controls in a row | footer actions, toolbar */
  --space-3: 12px; /* a panel's padding, a field's text inset | panel, input, menu */
  --space-4: 16px; /* between groups in a form | form, section gap */
  --space-5: 20px; /* a dialog's padding | dialog */
  --space-6: 24px; /* between sections | page section */
  --space-8: 32px; /* between page regions | page */
  --space-10: 40px; /* a page's top padding | page */
  --shell-inset: 3px; /* the gap between a card's shell and its panel: the 14px shell less the 11px panel | card, panel */
  --shell-foot-inset: 6px; /* the gap between the shell's edge and a footer action: the panel's 3px read as cramped beside a pill | card footer, dialog footer */

  /* == Size == */
  --control-sm: 26px; /* a small control | button sm, chip, footer action */
  --control: 32px; /* the default control | button, input, select, segmented control */
  --control-lg: 36px; /* a large control | button lg, prompt input field */
  --row: 36px; /* one row of a list, menu or table | table row, item, menu item */
  --icon-sm: 12px; /* an icon in a small control or a tag | button sm, badge */
  --icon: 14px; /* an icon in a control | button, input, menu item */
  --icon-lg: 16px; /* an icon in a large control or on its own | button lg */

  /* == Radius == */
  --radius-pill: 999px; /* every one-line control | button, input, select, segmented control, chip, badge */
  --radius-shell: 14px; /* a card's grey shell | card */
  --radius-panel: 11px; /* the white panel inside the shell, 3px in, so the corners stay concentric | card panel */
  --radius-overlay: 10px; /* a box that holds lines of text: overlays and text areas | menu, popover, dialog, textarea, code block */
  --radius-row-focus: calc(var(--radius-panel) - var(--line-width)); /* a focused row's corners: the panel's inner edge, so its ring follows the panel's corner | item, data grid row */
  --radius-tag: 6px; /* a box inside a row or an overlay | menu item, tag in a row, kbd */

  /* == Lines == */
  --line-width: 1px; /* every line: rings, edges, rules | glass ring, field, shell, overlay */
  --focus-width: 2px; /* the focus ring | every focusable */
  --focus-offset: 2px; /* the gap between a control and its ring | every focusable */
  --focus-width-sm: 1.5px; /* the ring on a control under 20px, so it does not outweigh the control | checkbox, radio, switch */
  --focus-offset-sm: 1px; /* the gap on a control under 20px | checkbox, radio, switch */

  /* == Motion: short, ease-out, no springs; things arrive from where they came from == */
  --dur-press: 120ms; /* a press on a flat control: the scale | secondary button, ghost */
  --dur-glass-press: 50ms; /* glass going down: the scale and the layers | glass active */
  --dur-glass-release: 200ms; /* glass coming back up | glass */
  --dur-state: 160ms; /* a state change: hover, a field's line, a check | every control */
  --dur-overlay: 200ms; /* an overlay in; it leaves on --dur-state | menu, popover, dialog, tooltip */
  --overlay-shift: 4px; /* how far an anchored overlay travels in from its trigger, and back out | menu, popover, select, tooltip */
  --scale-overlay: 0.97; /* the scale a modal overlay settles from and leaves to | dialog */
  --dur-spin: 800ms; /* one turn of the pending arc, a loop | button pending, spinner */
  --dur-slide: 200ms; /* a selection mark sliding to its new place: the segmented thumb, the pill tab | segmented control, tabs */
  --dur-sweep: 1400ms; /* one pass of the indeterminate segment along a progress track, the other loop | progress indeterminate */
  --wait-show: 150ms; /* how long a load waits before its skeleton or dim shows, so a fast answer never flashes | skeleton swap */
  --wait-hold: 400ms; /* how long a skeleton stays once it shows, so it never blinks | skeleton swap */
  --stale: 0.6; /* the opacity of content that is reloading behind a busy mark | skeleton swap */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); /* the house curve: arrives fast, settles | every transition */
  --ease-in: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); /* an element leaving | overlay exit */
  --scale-press-flat: 0.99; /* the scale a held secondary settles at, barely moving | secondary button */
  --scale-press: 0.97; /* the scale a held flat control settles at | secondary button, ghost */
  --scale-press-glass: 0.99; /* the scale held glass settles at, a slight give | glass */

  /* == Layers == */
  --z-raised: 10; /* a part lifted over its siblings inside a component | sticky header, focused segment */
  --z-sticky: 20; /* a bar that sticks to the page | sticky toolbar, bulk action bar */
  --z-overlay: 50; /* every portalled layer; the last opened sits on top by DOM order | dialog, popover, menu, tooltip, toast */

  /* == Layout == */
  --overlay-sm: 400px; /* a small dialog | alert dialog */
  --overlay: 480px; /* the default dialog and sheet width | dialog, sheet */
  --overlay-lg: 640px; /* a wide dialog: a preview, the command palette | dialog lg, command palette */
  --popover: 288px; /* a popover's width | popover */
  --toast: 360px; /* a toast's width on a wide screen; full width less the gutter on a phone | toast */
  --menu-min: 192px; /* the narrowest a menu opens | dropdown menu, select */
  --menu-row: 32px; /* one row of a menu or a command list, a step under --row | menu item, command item */
  --menu-row-sm: 28px; /* one row of a small menu, opened from a small control | menu item sm */
  --popup-max: 320px; /* the tallest a list popup grows before it scrolls | select, combobox, menu */
  --tooltip-max: 256px; /* a tooltip's line length before it wraps | tooltip */
  --label-col: 160px; /* the widest a label column grows before its labels wrap | data list, horizontal field */
  --progress-bar-sm: 4px; /* a small progress bar or meter, in a row or a card footer | progress sm */
  --progress-bar: 6px; /* the thickness of a progress bar or a meter | progress */
  --progress-bar-lg: 8px; /* a large progress bar, the one task on a screen | progress lg */
  --progress-sweep: 32%; /* the length of the segment that slides along an indeterminate bar | progress indeterminate */
  --measure: 68ch; /* a paragraph's longest line | prose, message */
  --measure-hint: 60ch; /* a description or hint's longest line | field hint, card description */

  /* == Scrollbar: one thin bar for every scrolling region, a thumb and no track == */
  --scrollbar-thumb: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.20); /* the thumb, ink at 20%: there when you look for it, quiet while you read | command list, menu, select list, sheet, table, code block */
  --scrollbar-size: 10px; /* the bar's gutter: a 6px thumb with --scrollbar-gap of clear on each side | every scrolling region */
  --scrollbar-gap: 2px; /* the clear around the thumb, so it floats off the panel's edge | every scrolling region */
}

/* The dark theme redefines the colour roles. Ink and paper swap: near-white ink on a near-black page. Ink glass turns
   to light glass with a dark label, and paper glass to dark glass with a light one, as the approved button sheet does.
   Coral and green glass turn light with an ink label. Light glass keeps the sheen and the rim but drops the dark
   centre, which would sit as a smudge under a dark label. The flat secondary is the dark panel: --paper, a light label and
   the panel's hairline in light ink. The surfaces keep light mode's order, read as ink added: the page darkest, the shell a step
   up, the panel (paper) a step above the shell, the grey field a step above that, so a card's panel and a raised
   overlay are the lightest things on screen. The scrim is pure black at 64%, because a near-black page barely
   changes under the fixed dark at 56%; what it dims is the panels and the text. */
[data-system="glaze"][data-theme="dark"], .glaze[data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] [data-system="glaze"], [data-theme="dark"] .glaze {
  --page: #0c0c0c;
  --paper: #1f1f1f;
  --shell: #161616;
  --field: #2a2a2a;
  --hover: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.06);
  --hover-row: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.04);
  --pressed: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.10);
  --scrim: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.64);

  --ink: #f4f4f3;
  --ink-80: #f4f4f3;
  --ink-60: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.60);
  --ink-45: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.45);
  --ink-32: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.34);
  --ink-15: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.15);
  --ink-10: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.10);
  --ink-06: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.06);
  --ink-03: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.03);

  --text-1: #f4f4f3;
  --text-2: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.60);
  --text-3: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.45);
  --text-disabled: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.34);
  --text-inverse: #050505;

  --line-faint: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.06);
  --line: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.10);
  --line-control: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.15);
  --line-focus: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.34);
  --line-strong: rgb(244 244 243 / 0.45);
  --focus: #f4f4f3;

  --ok: #3fbf75;
  --ok-text: #6fd69a;
  --ok-tint: #13261a;
  --warn: #f0a531;
  --warn-text: #f5c065;
  --warn-tint: #2a2010;
  --fail: #ec6f5a;
  --fail-text: #f2917f;
  --fail-tint: #2c1714;

  --glass-ink-base: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.62);
  --glass-ink-text: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.90);
  --glass-ink-ring: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.24);
  --glass-coral-base: rgb(245 140 120 / 0.86);
  --glass-coral-text: rgb(5 5 5 / 0.90);
  --glass-coral-ring: rgb(245 140 120 / 0.40);

/* Reduced motion: no press scale, no fades. The pending arc stays as a still mark (styles.css stops it). */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-system="glaze"], .glaze { --dur-press: 0ms; --dur-state: 0ms; --dur-overlay: 0ms; --scale-press: 1; --scale-press-flat: 1; --scale-press-glass: 1; --dur-glass-press: 0ms; --dur-glass-release: 0ms; --dur-slide: 0ms; }
}
